metas.name: Witch on the Holy Night
metas.description:
Genres: Action, Drama, Fantasy Tags:Magic/Urban Fantasy/Witch/Urban/Female Protagonist/Kuudere/Fairy Tale/School/Ensemble Cast/Male Protagonist/Philosophy/Robots/Werewolf Aoko Aozaki, an ordinary high school girl, is actually a Magician who lives in the modern world...though she is still only an apprentice. As she spends her days living alongside her housemate, Alice Kuonji, striving to become a full-fledged Magician...

The girl meets a boy.

This is the beginning of one young girl’s story — the tale of a Witch.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

metas.name: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend
metas.description:
Genres: Drama, Psychological, Romance, Supernatural Tags:Male Protagonist/Urban Fantasy/Female Protagonist/Coming of Age/Heterosexual/Primarily Adult Cast/College/Urban "Actually, I’m Touko Kirishima."

The audience erupted in excitement upon learning that the true identity of the mysterious, wildly popular internet singer was none other than the nation’s favorite actress, Mai Sakurajima. The scene was exactly the same as the dream Sakuta Azusagawa had seen on Christmas Eve.

Starting with Mai’s shocking confession on April 1, the impossible events that everyone once dreamed of keep happening one after another. The social media hashtag "#Yumemiru," where dreams come true, has vanished, and as Sakuta struggles with the disconnect between the reality before him and his own perception, he receives a message from a version of himself in an alternate reality.

―Stop Touko Kirishima,
―Before reality is rewritten.

To restore the world to its original state, Sakuta sets out to find Touko Kirishima. This is a story about overcoming the "Adolescent Syndrome".

(Source: Crunchyroll News, edited)

metas.name: The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady’s Treasure
metas.description:
Genres: Drama, Mystery Tags:Female Protagonist/Medicine/Historical/Ancient China/Seinen/Politics The curtains rise on a new mystery surrounding a secret treasure hidden in a city on the water.

The emperor gives Jinshi an order. He must grant the final wish of a concubine who passed away five years ago by returning her to her homeland. In order to return her to her family, Jinshi examines the remains, only to discover that they’re in pristine condition. She’s beautiful, as if she were still alive. To solve the mystery of the remains, Jinshi drags Maomao along on a journey to Binan-shu, the southern province ruled by the Bi clan.

They arrive at a bustling city on the water. Maomao is excited to see herbs and medicines she has never seen before, but tensions are high in the area, as pirates are viciously trying to find the treasure their late leader hid away.

“I hope nothing happens...”

Jinshi’s premonition comes true. On the day of the concubine’s funeral, a huge incident occurs, triggering a chain of events that nobody could see coming.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

metas.name: GROTESQQQUE
metas.description:
Genres: Action, Comedy, Drama, Sci-Fi, Slice of Life, Supernatural Tags:Anthology/Found Family/Monster Girl/Video Games/Aliens/Vampire/Gyaru/Post-Apocalyptic/Battle Royale/Survival/Virtual World/Yuri/Motorcycles/Cohabitation/LGBTQ+ Themes/Cute Girls Doing Cute Things/Kemonomimi Anthology movie consisting of three original animation segments:

Q1 - ÆLIENS (エリィアンズ)
Earth has entered an age of interplanetary exchange.
As fear and prejudice toward aliens spread across society, a young alien girl named Elie arrives as an interstellar goodwill ambassador. She adores Earth’s culture and its wonderfully pointless everyday life, and teams up with Kento Kunikura, a civil servant who works for the Space Bureau, to search for “friends” across the planet.

But Elie’s powers sometimes spiral out of control. As a mysterious alien surrounded by secrets, she soon attracts public attention and suspicion, and people gradually begin to see her as an “invader.”

Then, without warning, hostile aliens appear──!?

Q2 - Yoroshiku★Shoujo (夜露死駆★少女)
In the city of GALs TOKYO, morning never comes.
Every night, girls known as “Gal Ps” gather there—girls who no longer have a place for themselves in the real world.

They all seek the same goal: to become the ultimate victor in a game called Queen of Butterfly, or QoB for short, and claim the title of “Queen.”

A truant girl named STELLA hears rumors of an urban legend and throws herself into the deadly game. Girls kill and fall, scattering like butterflies in the night. In the middle of the chaos, STELLA encounters a mysterious girl carrying an SSS-ranked weapon and wielding overwhelming power. Through her, STELLA uncovers the hidden truth behind the game──

Q3 - Nocturne: Kono Grotesque na Yoru ni (ノクターン～このグロテスクな夜に～)
In a world where humanity has already perished, a pureblood vampire named Ayame travels in a wagon car alongside three girls who survived by becoming “infected” through her blood.
Above them, countless stars light up the night like daylight, while golden fields shimmer across the ruined earth. Through a vampire’s eyes, even a devastated world can look breathtakingly beautiful.
Together, the girls cherish the small, quiet moments of life left behind in this empty world.

“Even if a vampire’s body perishes, the soul never disappears.”
When Ayame quietly speaks those words, Shion senses the loneliness and despair hidden within someone doomed to live forever.

Then one day, something strange begins to happen to Ayame, and the girls’ unchanging everyday life slowly starts to crack apart.

(Souce: Aniplex USA)

metas.name: To You in the Beyond
metas.description:
Genres: Mystery, Romance Tags:Classical Music/Coastal/Rural The story centers on a boy named Kazuki Tsukigase, who transfers to a high school on a remote island to get away from anyone who knows him. Kazuki finds out that there is an inlet on the island where people are rumored to disappear. Exploring the inlet, he encounters an unconscious girl. When she comes to after Kazuki takes her to the clinic, she is unable to give out anything about her identity except that she is named Nao, is 16 years old, and whispers the year "1974."

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)
